subject: Renewal orchestration: timeline, stakeholder map, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@brightscale.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightscale.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning + capacity increase — brightscale

Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks for the platform support over the last year — we've seen solid latency and cost improvements since the initial migration. We're starting our renewal planning and want to kick off a short roadmap/QBR and mutual action plan. High level: 

- We're targeting a 24-month renewal (currently on 12 months)
- Expected committed throughput to increase ~2.5x (concurrency and monthly token volume)
- Interested in pricing for Dedicated capacity + a small pilot of Redwood Optimize for cost optimization

Can we schedule a 45–60 min kickoff the week of Apr 6? Our procurement lead (Priya) will need timeline/PO guidance. I've attached a one-page internal note on expected capacity growth. Proposed times (PST): Apr 7 10:00, Apr 7 15:00, Apr 8 11:00.

Attendees from our side: Jordan (engineering), Priya (procurement), Devon (product). Please confirm who from Redwood should join and any prework you'd like us to complete.

Thanks,

Jordan Miles
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightScale Analytics

Attachments: BrightScale_Renewal_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 34 KB)

To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@brightscale.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightscale.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal planning + capacity increase — brightscale

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. Happy to kick this off.

Quick notes / proposal: 
- Proposed kickoff: Apr 7 at 10:00 PST (we can move if that doesn't work). I've tentatively booked a slot on my calendar.
- Agenda (45 min): 1) recap usage and pain points (10m), 2) capacity needs and performance targets (10m), 3) pricing options and term tradeoffs (12m), 4) mutual action plan / next steps & owners (13m).
- For pricing conversation: assuming 2.5x committed throughput we can show a Dedicated vs hosted blended model and a 24-month commit discount. I will pull preliminary math and a SOW draft.

Requested attendees from Redwood: me (AE), Marissa (CS lead), and Neha (sales ops) for pricing/PO cadence. Evelyn (your AM director) — would appreciate if you can join for the pricing/approval portion.

Prework for BrightScale: if you can share 30d / 90d concurrency & monthly token projections (rough is fine) before Apr 6 that will help us prepare.

Attaching a short kickoff agenda and a SOW stub to iterate on.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Internal note before we reply to procurement: 

- Pricing guidance: for a 24-month commit + 2.5x throughput, recommend offering a blended Dedicated discount of ~28-32% vs list, plus a 6-month transition discount on burst capacity. If they want Redwood Optimize pilot, offer a $15k pilot credit and include performance SLA addendum for Dedicated.
- Attachments to provide: SOW_V1 (we have Marcus' stub), SOC2 summary + evidence pointer (link to secure drive), and a DocuSign-ready SOW by Apr 15 to hit their Apr 20 review target.
- Owner assignments: Marcus (primary AE / deal lead), Marissa (CS / QBR owner), Neha (contracts & PO coordination), Evelyn (discount approval up to 30%); if discount >30% we escalate to Sales Director.

Marcus — I'll draft the SOW changes (capacity table + billing cadence) and a one-page pricing comparison for their finance team.

-Marissa
